auditor_julia: Hi team — auditor here. For the SOC 2 evidence packet we need a few items related to INC-2026 (customer X):
1) Cross-region KMS/keystore access logs for Apr 1–7 (us-west-2 + eu-central-1)
2) Proof of retention policy showing 13 months for access logs + manifest
3) Incident timeline and repro notes showing auth 401s + the correlated billing spike during the key rotation window.
Deadline: EOW. Thanks.

maria_k: @auditor_julia noted. Looping in @devsec_ops and @samira. We're starting exports now. Confirming scope: all keystore/KMS events Apr 1 00:00 UTC -> Apr 7 23:59 UTC for both regions?

auditor_julia: Yes — exact window above. We need raw logs (compressed) and a filtered CSV with these events: GenerateKey, Encrypt, Decrypt, ReEncrypt, RotateKey, DescribeKey, GetPublicKey, ListKeyPolicies.

devsec_ops: We can produce S3 exports. I'll upload to: s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2834567890/kms-exports/ — will include md5/sha256 checksums and a signed manifest (PGP). ETA ~3 hours. @incident-bot can you attach the incident timeline snapshot?

incident-bot: INC-2026 timeline attached: 2026-04-03T02:12Z detection -> 2026-04-03T02:17Z alert -> 2026-04-03T02:25Z mitigation (rollback key rotation) -> 2026-04-03T02:40Z recovery. Report: https://redwood.incidents/reports/INC-2026 :page_facing_up:

samira: Adding the repro steps we used to reproduce the 401s and billing surge. Note: run only in staging with test keys.

```
# repro script (bash)
for i in {1..500}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/decrypt \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \n    -d '{"ciphertext": "BASE64_PAYLOAD"}' &
done
wait
```

jonathan_p: Also pulling kernel/runtime traces from inference nodes that show retries and token-level retries that explain the billing spike. Example query we ran against analytics: 
```
SELECT timestamp, request_id, user_id, api_path, status_code, cost_tokens
FROM api_events
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-04-03' AND '2026-04-04'
  AND user_id = 'customer-x'
ORDER BY timestamp;
```

kevin_s: Retention proof is in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/controls/log-retention — shows 13 months for access logs, 7 years for archived audit bundles. Also adding manifest: s3://redwood-evidence/controls/retention-policy-2026.pdf

auditor_julia: Thanks. Couple of last asks: 1) cryptographic checksums for each exported object (sha256 preferred) + signed manifest; 2) evidence that exports are immutable once generated (object lock or archive workflow); 3) the sampling plan / selection criteria used for any sampled logs.

devsec_ops: Will include sha256 checksums and a PGP-signed manifest. Exports are copied to an Object Lock bucket with Governance mode and retention applied — we will include the bucket policy snapshot and S3 object lock manifest. Sampling plan: we used a stratified sample across peak hours and the rotation window. Query we used for the sample: 
```
-- sampling query
WITH peaks AS (
  SELECT hour(timestamp) AS h, count(*) AS cnt
  FROM access_logs
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-07'
  GROUP BY h ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3
)
SELECT *
FROM access_logs
WHERE hour(timestamp) IN (SELECT h FROM peaks)
  AND region IN ('us-west-2','eu-central-1')
  AND event IN ('Decrypt','Encrypt','GenerateKey','RotateKey')
LIMIT 1000;
```

auditor_julia: Good. Also need the PR/trace for the rotation rollout and the approval chain (email or Slack) that authorized the key rotation during that window.

maria_k: PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4521 — includes rollout plan and canary steps. Approval: samira approved on Apr 2 21:50 UTC (Slack thread and email export will be added to the bundle).

auditor_julia: ETA for full evidence bundle?

devsec_ops: :thumbsup: We'll upload the full bundle + signed manifest to s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2834567890/bundle.zip and publish sha256 sums here by EOD (2026-04-10 23:59 UTC). Assigning owner @kevin_s for compliance sign-off.

kevin_s: On it — I will review the bundle once uploaded and ack with a compliance stamp :eyes:
